reviews.text:
I can’t recommend Sam Neezer highly enough. He is without a doubt, the best dog trainer I have ever come across! A true dog whisperer.

What makes Sam stand out from all the trainers out there is the incredible way he communicates with dogs. He has a natural ability to understand their behaviour and respond in a way that is calm, intuitive, and deeply effective. His techniques are genuinely transformative. You can see the trust and respect he builds with every dog he works with.

Beyond his skill, the love that Sam has for dogs is undeniable. Sam’s passion for dog training is unmistakable, he approaches every session with great enthusiasm and an unwavering commitment to helping each dog reach its full potential. He goes above and beyond in every session, showing dedication, and a real commitment to achieving lasting results.

If you’re looking for someone who truly understands dogs and delivers exceptional outcomes, Sam is simply outstanding.

We worked with Sam for our Mini Dachshund, Luna, after she became more reactive, particularly with bigger dogs.  She was also pulling a lot on the lead, coupled with her unpredictable barking, this made walks very stressful.

Sam’s training style really focuses on positive engagement, therefore creating a stronger bond with your dog. Sam was extremely patient, supportive and took the time to explain to us why Luna was reacting the way she was and offered us a lot of guidance during and in between sessions.

After these sessions with Sam, I can’t believe how much Luna’s behaviour has changed. She is much calmer, way more engaged with us, and we feel much more confident handling situations that used to be challenging as Sam gave us the practical tools to do so.

We would 100% recommend Sam for anyone looking for a dog trainer and if we ever need guidance again, Sam will be the person we will go to. Thanks so much Sam!

We did lots of research into what we needed to support our terrier who was showing unpredictable reactive behaviour towards one dog and we are so grateful to have had the opportunity to work with Sam. He is incredibly patient and talented …

We came to Sam because we wanted to help our dog with her leash manners. Sam walked us through the process and helped get us on the right track! We’ve kept consistent with it and she’s actually walking so much better these days :)

Excellent trainer! Sam explains what the dog is thinking, and why, and therefore how we can get the best, and lasting, results. He is very patient and kind, with both me and my dog. My dog loves to be with Sam, and Sam has helped her become so much more responsive and easier to walk. We're going to keep working with him!

Sam was so helpful during a very difficult period. He has a very calm and respectful manner, and clearly knows what he is talking about and doing when it comes to dogs. Thank you Sam for being so kind. Would recommend!

Far and away the best. Sam is truly gifted with dogs. Our little guy was a big-fat terror. But Sam, through gentle guidance and correction, got him calm and under control. Sam's philosophy is to help your dog through positive reinforcement. …

I can’t recommend Sam enough! He has done an absolutely fantastic job with my very overexcited Labrador Remi. From day one, his calm and confident approach put both me and Remi at ease, and the results speak for themselves. …

Sam was fantastic for the month that we used him! Over the years, I've encountered a lot of dog trainers and behaviourists, but none have ever been like Sam. His unwavering dedication to his work clearly affects how well his teaching is …

Sam really understands dog behaviour. He had my 5 year rescue Doberman for 14 day residential training and she came back a new dog. She no longer pulls on lead, is fine in busy places and has come out of her anxious space and happy whereever she is. I can’t recommend Sam enough as you can tell he loves dogs and dogs love him.
